question: Annapurna Devi was known to practice which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surbahar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annapurna Devi **was a renowned Indian classical musician who belonged to the **Maihar Gharana.**
 
• She was born in **1927 in Maihar, Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• She was known to practice the **Surbahar,** which is a **stringed instrument** similar to the sitar but with a** lower tone.**
 
• Annapurna Devi was considered a **master of this instrument** and was one of the few female musicians to achieve such recognition in her time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sarod** is another stringed instrument that is popular in **Indian classical music.**

 
 
• It has a **deeper sound** than the sitar and is played with a **pick**.
 
• The Sarod is often used in **North Indian classical music. **
 
 
 
• **The Violin **is a Western classical instrument that is played with a **bow.**
 
 
• It is **not** commonly used in Indian classical music, although some musicians have experimented with incorporating it into their performances.
 
 
 
• The** Bamboo Flute **is a wind instrument that is commonly used in** Indian classical music.**
 
 
• It is also known as the **Bansuri** and is made from** bamboo reeds of varying sizes**.
 
• It is often used to **create melodic lines **in performances.
